titulo: Middle East crisis: US carries out strikes across Iran as Tehran targets American bases in region – as it happened
cuerpo: Latest attacks come after Trump vowed ‘major military punishment’ for Tehran and its Houthi allies As we reported earlier, Iran ’s military said on Friday that it carried out attacks targeting US military assets in Bahrain , Jordan and Kuwait in retaliation for Washington’s latest strikes on the Islamic republic. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Corp, meanwhile, said they had targeted a data centre in Bahrain belonging to Amazon , according to state media, though neither the US tech giant nor Bahrain have commented on the claim.
